August has arrived, and the $50 discount on AirPods Pro 3, the $100 discount on AirPods Max 2, and the all-time low price on AirTag 2 are still going strong. But today's headliner in the 9to5Toys lunchtime deal roundup is the M5 MacBook Air — we spotted a rare $200 discount on the 24GB/512GB model, while the official Apple Certified Refurbished store also has up to $300 off select configurations, including this 24GB 15-inch model (more on that here). Those deals join various Apple Watch Ultra 3 configurations with close to $100 off, the latest Beats 240W Braided USB-C Cable (Black) back at $18, and a chance to score transparent red Beats Solo Buds for $40. Scroll down for all the details.

Apple's official refurbished store now has the lowest prices on M5 MacBook Air, up to $300 off

A fresh round of MacBook price hikes has now worked its way through retail, and while we have already tracked deals with up to $500 off, Apple's official Certified Refurbished store is now offering the best deals on select M5 MacBook Air configurations. We previously featured the lowest-price base model from a trusted source, but you can also land this 24GB 15-inch model for $300 below the new MSRP over at the store, available in Midnight, Silver, Starlight, and Sky Blue.

Apple's official refurbished store is now selling the 15-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 24GB RAM and 1TB of storage for $1,699 shipped. As noted above, this offer applies to all four colors: Midnight, Silver, Starlight, and Sky Blue.

This MacBook Air originally retails for $1,900, and right now Amazon has all configurations listed for over $1,999.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (originally $1,299 new) — $200 off
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,359 (originally $1,599 new) — $240 off
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,699 (originally $1,999 new) — $300 off

Today's refurbished store deal essentially brings this machine back to its previous pricing, and it's the best discount we've seen since the price hikes took effect. It looks like these new MSRPs are going to stick around through the end of the year, if not longer. So while this isn't the all-time low price we've tracked, it's a solid chance to save for anyone looking to pick up an M5 MacBook Air this year — chances are, we won't see anything like it on the next MacBook Air lineup until 2027.

Head over to Apple's refurbished store to browse all the MacBook deals — use the filters on the left side of the page to narrow down to the model you want.

Cheapest 15-inch 24GB M5 MacBook Air is $200 off today

Ongoing deal: 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro sees massive $500 price drop at Amazon

MacBooks just got a price hike, but Amazon this morning is still offering a massive $500 discount on the M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB/2TB. This is right in line with the best prices we saw before the price increase. More details below.

Amazon is now selling the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB RAM and 2TB of storage for $2,499 shipped.

Considering this machine currently retails for $2,999 at Apple and elsewhere, this is a straight-up $500 price drop. The offer applies to both the Space Black and Silver models.

This is the best deal we've tracked on an M5 Pro model since the major retailers hiked prices.

Previously, the deepest Amazon had gone on this machine was $300, but this one takes an extra $200 off.

While it still doesn't beat the price we saw on this configuration before the official price hikes, there's not much we can do about that — time travel isn't an option. All things considered, especially given the price hike this machine saw about a month ago, this deal comes within $100 of the all-time low price we've tracked on this M5 Pro.

Black and Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 models drop nearly $100 at Amazon

Update: As expected, Amazon has now also dropped the prices on several other Ultra 3 configurations, including the Natural Titanium model with an Anchor Blue Ocean Band, down by nearly $100. More details below.

While the Series 11 lineup has been seeing steady discounts, like this round from earlier in August, Apple Watch Ultra 3 discounts have been a bit harder to come by. However, this morning we spotted Amazon offering the Black Ultra 3 with a black one size fits just about everyone Ocean Band for nearly $100 off.

Amazon is now selling the Black Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with a Black Ocean Band for $699.99 shipped.

Originally $799, this is just under $100 below MSRP and the best brand-new deal we've found at a reputable retailer.

Outside of that brief $150 discount during Amazon Prime Day, this matches the best deal we've seen all year, and one of the few times we've tracked notable discounts on Amazon.

At the time of writing, the Black model with Ocean Band is the only configuration seeing a notable discount. But if this drop follows the pattern of the last one, we expect to see other colorways follow suit throughout the day and week.

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Black Ocean Band $700 (originally $799)
  • Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Anchor Blue Ocean Band $700 (originally $799)
  • Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Blue Trail Loop $700 (originally $799)
  • Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop $800 (originally $899)

If you're after the Series 11, you can get in for much less right now:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (originally $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (originally $429)

Latest Beats 240W Braided USB-C Cable (Black) drops back to Prime member low of $18 shipped, new all-time low (40% off)

Score transparent red Beats Solo Buds for as low as $41 today

The Solo Buds are Beats' most affordable wireless earbuds right now, and the onboard battery life impressed us in our testing. But at $80 MSRP and typically $70 at Amazon, picking up a pair for $41 shipped at Best Buy is all the more appealing. Browse all Best Buy Beats deals here and keep reading for more on this Solo Buds deal.

Best Buy is now selling "excellent" condition open-box Beats Solo Buds (Transparent Red) for $40.99 shipped. That's nearly 50% off the MSRP and well below the $70 you'll pay for a brand-new pair at Amazon.

  • Full functionality and like-new appearance.
  • All accessories and parts included, though packaging may be different or missing.

These are admittedly more entry-level earbuds, but what we're looking at is a current-generation pair of earbuds from an Apple-owned brand for just $41.

As noted above, and confirmed in our hands-on testing, the onboard battery in the buds themselves does in fact deliver up to 18 hours of listening time on a full charge. That's not a wireless charging case with its own battery in the box, but for most folks, that's plenty — especially at $41. Other features include "one-touch seamless pairing," custom mics with "advanced noise-learning algorithms" for standout call quality, and industry-leading Class 1 Bluetooth.
